architecture.canonicalHistory: the mature OrdivonAgentLoop retains complete Run-local execution history for progress, recovery and Tool correlation independently from the messages selected for one Provider turn
architecture.modelView: an optional internal WorkingViewProjector supplies each Provider turn's exact context digest and model-visible messages without rewriting canonical history
architecture.workingSetProjector: WorkingSetViewProjector deterministically compiles the current committed HarnessWorkingSetSpec and its exact pinned CAS sources; it performs no discovery, ranking or automatic transition
architecture.claimFence: Provider claim revalidates under the Run lease that an exact AgentTurnRequest still equals the current committed WorkingView before any physical Provider dispatch

behavior.multiTurnProjection: a mature two-turn Agent Loop can dispatch WorkingView A on turn 1, explicitly replan to committed WorkingView B, and dispatch only B on turn 2 while preserving the complete canonical first-turn and correction history
behavior.staleProjection: if the WorkingSet advances after projection but before Provider claim, the stale request is rejected and the physical Provider invocation count remains zero
behavior.responseLoss: after two physical Provider turns, loss of the second completion response leaves turn 2 durably COMPLETED and its exact B request/result replayable from fresh continuity without a third physical dispatch
behavior.privacy: a metadata-only Run may use an ephemeral projected model view for Provider disclosure without making the projected content durable; a full state-root sentinel scan records zero hits
behavior.trace: model_view_projected is a first-class closed-vocabulary Trace event containing WorkingSet/WorkingView/message digests rather than substituting the projected content for canonical Run history

conclusion: P-C1.2b proves that the mature multi-turn Agent Loop can separate canonical execution history from the model-visible per-turn WorkingView without weakening Provider dispatch fencing, response-loss replay or P-C1.2a metadata-only privacy. The Provider no longer has to consume the accumulated canonical transcript merely because Harness keeps that history for execution truth.
knownLimits: WorkingSet transition is still explicit caller/domain/Agent-integration behavior. P-C1.2b does not yet define a model-visible action by which the Agent itself requests, revises or commits its WorkingSet.
There is no Context discovery, search, ranking, RAG, Memory, summarization, evidence-sufficiency policy or automatic Context scheduler in this slice.

The response-loss proof reopens fresh continuity and replays the exact completed second Provider turn at the durable Provider boundary with zero redispatch; full automatic mature-Loop process re-entry after an arbitrary later-turn crash remains a separate recovery slice.

The committed WorkingSet source path still requires model-content retention authority. Metadata-only can use an ephemeral projection but cannot durably reconstruct intentionally omitted WorkingView content without caller-authorized rehydration.

The mature Tool-bearing path still keeps canonical messages for Tool correlation/recovery. P-C1.2b validates the projection seam on no-Tool multi-turn execution and does not yet prove Tool-bearing WorkingView replacement.
WorkingSetViewProjector and WorkingViewProjector remain internal experimental seams and are not exported from the recommended ordivon_harness.api facade.
